prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. Shot through a heat camera: every surface is coloured by its temperature, the hottest things blazing white and yellow, warm bodies orange and red, cold walls fading through magenta to deep blue, the coldest corners icy violet-black. Every shape and detail is still a real photograph. Camera low beside the furnace door, the shovel blade in the foreground. A stoker in a vest, with a thick neck, a shaved head and a broken nose, shovels banknotes into the roaring mouth of a basement furnace; its heating pipe climbs the brick wall and stops dead at the ceiling. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
